notablePrerequisites: Nyxborn Rollicker attached to Mogis's Warhound.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Mogis's Warhound, adding {R}.
Mogis's Warhound leaves the battlefield, causing Nyxborn Rollicker to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Mogis's Warhound from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Mogis's Warhound for its bestow cost by paying {R}, attaching it to Nyxborn Rollicker.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nyxborn Rollicker, adding {R}.
Nyxborn Rollicker leaves the battlefield, causing Mogis's Warhound to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Nyxborn Rollicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Nyxborn Rollicker for its bestow cost by paying {R}, attaching it to Mogis's Warhound.
Repeat.
